sloka: राजा सत्यम् च धर्मश्च राजा कुलवताम् कुलम् ।राजा माता पिता चैव राजा हितकरो नृणाम् ॥२-६७-३४॥
transliteration: rājā satyam ca dharmaśca rājā kulavatām kulam ।rājā mātā pitā caiva rājā hitakaro nṛṇām ॥2-67-34॥

translations.english: The king is the protector of truth and righteousness, of men of good families. He is father, and mother. He alone renders welfare of the people.
